lines.differs: Better for AtliQ than Harrington Health Systems Inc: the Purpose covers ongoing engagement rather than being limited to evaluating a potential engagement.
Better for AtliQ than Meridian Healthcare: information exchange is mutual rather than one-way, and covers ongoing engagement instead of only evaluation.
Worse for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: it defines only the Purpose and fails to define Confidential Information or specify protected categories.
